source: Generic double-sided FR4 prototyping board (typical green 2.54 mm proto board). Family data: width and depth come from the request; thickness 1.6 is the standard FR4 laminate; corner holes 3.0 mm at 2.5 mm from each edge unless stated (catalogue family default; OWNER_DECISIONS: variants keep their own boards); a 2.54 mm hole array centred on the board, with the edge-pad column outside the grid (requirements.md A7, OWNER_DECISIONS 1). The owner's photographed 70 x 50 board (requirements.md A7, 2026-10-24: corner holes 2.0 in from each edge, diameter 2.0; 24 x 18 grid from X 5.79, Y 3.41; photo fitted at 5.51 px/mm) is the specimen photo_70x50 below, selected by size.
frame: board: origin at the min-X, min-Y corner of the top surface, X along width, Y along depth, Z up; the board occupies Z -thickness..0

hole_inset.source: typical green 2.54 mm proto board; catalogue family default, corner holes 3.0 mm at 2.5 mm from each edge unless stated (OWNER_DECISIONS: variants keep their own boards)

hole_diameter.source: typical green 2.54 mm proto board; catalogue family default, corner holes 3.0 mm at 2.5 mm from each edge unless stated (OWNER_DECISIONS: variants keep their own boards)

hole_keepout_diameter.source: the board's component and fastener keep-out round each mounting hole: no part or printed feature inside this circle above or below the board (requirements.md V-SEAT-k / V-HOLE-KO-k, 7.0 columns on PERF_HOLE_k)

grid_margin_x.source: minimum distance from a short (X) edge to the first grid column centre: the edge-pad column centre (~2.2, A7) plus one pitch, so the pad column lies outside the grid; any value in (4.52, 5.79] reproduces A7's 24 columns on a 70 mm board, 4.74 is the physical rule (pad column + one pitch)

grid_margin_y.source: minimum distance from a long (Y) edge to the first grid row centre: one pitch (the board has no pad row along its long edges, A7); any value in (2.14, 3.41] reproduces A7's 18 rows on a 50 mm board

gate_params.source: sample size used only by the load-time validation gate; never a design value

specimens.source: requirements.md A7: the owner's photographed board (2026-10-24), corner holes 2.0 in from each edge, Ø2.0 (hole + plated ring ~2.1); pitch 66.0 x 46.0 on 70 x 50

grid.source: requirements.md A7: measured hole array, centred on the board (the largest whole number of pitches that keeps every hole at least grid_margin_x/y from the edges); edge pads are not grid holes

self_checks.name: hole pattern X pitch = width - 2 inset
hole pattern Y pitch = depth - 2 inset
first grid column at least grid_margin_x from the edge
first grid row at least grid_margin_y from the edge
mounting-hole keep-out larger than the hole
